editorial.tldr: Reinforcement Learning is a loose grouping of agentic-RL papers, not one developing story. Since Oct 19 it has gathered research-state search training, memory-skill learning, and a study of when fine-grained credit assignment helps or hurts.
editorial.whats_new: Nov 3: MDSKILL, an arXiv paper, internalizes skill memory into agent weights through multi-view on-policy self-distillation, complementing RL for self-evolving agents.
editorial.why_it_matters: Agent RL is shifting from prompt-held memory toward training signals: MDSKILL distills skill memory into the policy, and the Oct 26 credit-assignment study warns finer signals do not always help. All are paper-reported results, not production evidence.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you keep skill memory in prompts, rerun your evals against a distilled variant before committing, and A/B fine-grained credit against episode-level reward; treat all of these results as unreplicated.

status.detail: A loose set of agentic-RL papers; the newest moves skill memory from the prompt into the model via self-distillation.
